name: Patient Zero: Plague Idle
storyline:
Can you destroy humanity?

Patient Zero Pandemic Simulator is an intense virus simulator with strategic elements, where your goal is to create a deadly disease and bring it to a global catastrophe. Starting with "patient zero," you must adapt the virus, evolving it to overcome all the barriers humanity puts in place to survive.

DETAILED WORLD
Immerse yourself in a hyper-realistic world where every infection is influenced by a variety of factors, from climate and transportation to healthcare and population density.

15 TYPES OF DISEASES
Infect the world by choosing from 15 disease types, each with unique mutations and developmental possibilities.

LARGE INFECTION MAP
Infect all countries, interact with hundreds of traits, and create diverse virus-spreading scenarios.

GLOBAL EVENTS
Prepare for global catastrophes and decide how to adapt your pathogen to government actions and changing conditions.

STRATEGY AND TACTICS
Will you save the world or destroy it? Develop your plague, plan your moves, and determine the fate of humanity.
summary: Patient Zero: Plague Idle is a strategic virus simulator where you start by infecting "patient zero" and develop a deadly disease. Adapt the virus, overcome humanity's protective measures, and aim for either a global catastrophe or the salvation of the world.
